annotations.title: Case Green EPBD IV Building Decarbonization Auditor

description:
[Deterministic building energy decarbonization audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Computes mandatory 2030 (-16%) and 2035 (-21%) primary energy cut targets under EPBD IV Directive (EU) 2024/1275 ('Case Green'), audits worst-performing 43% building stock, and flags statutory 2025 fossil boiler subsidy prohibitions.
Usage: Use this tool to evaluate real estate energy performance, mandatory renovation trajectories, and heating decarbonization under EPBD IV.
Returns: JSON object with { isWorstPerformingBuildingStock: boolean, baselineAnnualPrimaryEnergyKwh: number, epbd2030Target: object, epbd2035Target: object, heatingSystemCompliance: object, renovationRoadmap: array }.

epglNren_kWh_m2_year.description: EPgl,nren non-renewable primary energy index from APE certificate

floorAreaM2.description: Useful heated floor area in square meters
